material_question: Whether avoidable adjacent full close/reopen turnover, rather than the funding signal, explains the negative AR2 BTC cost scenarios.
prior_result: Published AR2 BTC totals (+17.79110437593954 base, -82.25798634520652 adverse, -117.41943116522634 compression) were encountered during the source-file search before this dossier. Published ETH summaries also appeared incidentally; ETH will not be evaluated. All these historical periods were already consulted and are not out-of-sample.
why_the_prior_result_does_not_answer_thi: The preserved simulator always closes before a new decision. It does not isolate costs of matched same-instrument inventory at contiguous renewal boundaries. A generous upper bound can determine whether a delta-execution rewrite could change the adverse conclusion without building another strategy.
activation_reason: H1's primary public Arbitrum RPC cannot supply the probed historical state (missing trie node); the single fallback endpoint failed DNS. H1 is DATA_ACCESS_BLOCKED, not economically rejected.

fixed_design.signal: Unchanged AR2 from the preserved absolute-research protocol
fixed_design.first_measurement: Verify raw and normalized source hashes, rerun BTC AR2 only for the three existing cost scenarios and reconcile the saved reference. Detect only adjacent exit_ms == next entry_ms with identical spot/perpetual reference prices and contract identity. Non-adjacent trades cannot save renewal turnover.
fixed_design.turnover_accounting: For each leg, compare q_before + q_after with abs(q_after-q_before) at the same boundary reference price and declared fee/slippage. Savings equal 2*min(q_before,q_after)*price*bps/10000. No cross-venue or cross-instrument netting; unchanged quantity means hold, not two fills.
fixed_design.strict_cost_only_upper_bound: Reference cash remainder plus all modeled execution cost at eligible adjacent closes/reopens, even waiving the necessary delta trade. Preserve original signed funding, basis cashflows, all non-renewal costs and fixed overhead. This is deliberately more generous than actual delta execution.
fixed_design.extended_optimistic_upper_bound: Also waive the renewal entry's entire original unhedged-shock cost and add all positive entry-hour funding at max(old_quantity,new_quantity), with negative additional boundary funding set to zero only for this explicitly optimistic upper bound. Existing negative funding remains in the reference. This bound is not a signed-funding replay or expected profit.
fixed_design.boundary_funding_disclosure: Separately report positive and negative missed boundary receipts and the signed min(old_quantity,new_quantity) continuity diagnostic. A full replay, if needed, must include negative funding and distinguish quantity changes from uninterrupted holdings.
fixed_design.decision_rule: If even the extended optimistic bound remains non-positive in the adverse/compression scenarios, close the hypothesis that renewal execution alone fixes those losses. Preserve any base-case positivity and avoid extrapolating rejection to all possible regimes, capital sizes or redesigned policies. If the bound permits a changed decision, implement and reconcile the fixed reference quantity trajectory before claiming an improvement.
fixed_design.capital_sensitivity: After the bound, show analytical 1000/5000/25000 USDT proportional-notional scenarios with the same fixed overhead. These are labeled scale-only sensitivities, not additional backtests; changed grid, capacity, actual fees and execution are unverified. No scenario authorizes capital.

source_access: Read preserved raw market data and canonical old evidence; write new results only in the separate research worktree.
no_reopening_or_mutation: Original AR2 code, signal or outcomes
